redfin.remarks: Introducing this spacious 3-bedroom, 2-bath ground-level condo with a unique direct private home-like entry offering 1,210 square feet of comfortable living in a highly desirable Westside location of Beverlywood. A standout feature of the home is its two private patios —a welcoming front patio and a larger rear patio—creating multiple outdoor spaces for relaxing, dining, and entertaining. Inside, the living room features a cozy fireplace and tile flooring, while the galley-style kitchen offers marble countertops, ample cabinetry, and a functional layout. Two secondary bedrooms feature ceramic tile flooring , including one with built-in shelving and views of the rear patio, while the other offers a walk-in closet and direct access to the spacious rear patio. The primary suite enjoys abundant natural light, crown molding, a generous closet, and a beautifully designed ensuite bathroom featuring dual sinks, marble countertops, and a modern full bath. Double-pane windows provide added comfort and insulation, while central heating and air conditioning keep the home comfortable year-round. An in-unit stackable washer and dryer adds everyday convenience. Additional highlights include tandem parking spaces #38 and #39, a private storage bin, and an EV charger. Community amenities include a pool, fitness center, sauna, and library, while HOA dues include earthquake insurance, gas, water, sewer, and trash. Ideally situated moments from Hillcrest Country Club, Beverly Hills, Pico-Robertson area, Century City and Westfield Century City Mall, Cheviot Hills Recreation Center, Rancho Park Golf Course, neighborhood cafés and restaurants, and highly regarded Canfield Elementary School!
